title: Builder after the first win: write the Success Process (recipe)
shows: First practice game, a won clean task. With no rule yet, the Builder writes a Success Process: a general condition -> steps sentence plus the winning game's own steps as the example. The Beta posterior starts at (1,1).
why_interesting: The origin of every recipe in the manual. Its text is checked by code (<= 45 words, no numbered objects, no steps of other task kinds).

practice_game.goal: clean some fork and put it in drawer.

first_attempt_trace.observation: You arrive at diningtable 1. On the diningtable 1, you see a apple 3, a butterknife 3, a egg 1, a fork 1, a lettuce 1, a peppershaker 2, a saltshaker 3, and a spatula 2.
You pick up the fork 1 from the diningtable 1.
You arrive at sinkbasin 1. On the sinkbasin 1, you see a potato 1, and a tomato 1.
You clean the fork 1 using the sinkbasin 1.
You arrive at drawer 1. On the drawer 1, you see nothing.
You move the fork 1 to the drawer 1.

operations.example: go to diningtable 1, take fork 1, go to sinkbasin 1, clean fork 1 with sinkbasin 1, go to drawer 1, move fork 1 to drawer 1
operations.rule: When an object must be cleaned and placed: search the table first, take the object, go to the sink, clean it with the sink, go to the target container, move it there.
